title: At a single blocking obstacle (a bell-ringer's shade), two different failed social-check attempts (a will-based bluff, then a wits-based honest answer) each independently cost Watch standing before a third, unrelated grace check finally succeeded — bad luck on retries can stack multiple reputation losses against one guard.
